parsed.note_claim: There were 62 million visits to the larger aggregator website that linked to this group, not the group itself.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The website, which had around 62 million visits in February alone and whose core audience is in the United States, describes itself as a "moral free file host where anything legal is hosted forever."
parsed.reason: The article explicitly attributes the 62 million visits figure to the website Motherless.com, distinguishing it from the Telegram group which had nearly a thousand users.
